v13-9.candidate: For the Lord commanded me by a word: ‘Do not eat bread, drink water, or return by the road you traveled.’”

v13-17.candidate: because the Lord commanded me by a word, ‘Do not eat bread there or drink water there, nor return by the road you traveled.’”

v13-21.candidate: He said to the man of God who had come from Judah, “Thus says the Lord: Because you defied the Lord’s word and did not keep the commandment the Lord your God gave you,
